entities.name: Surtland
entities.description: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim, a wintry realm of constant turmoil with frost and fire giants.

entities.name: Frost giants
entities.description: Giants whose ice palaces dot the peaks.

entities.name: Fire giants
entities.description: Giants with crude shelters in the lowlands.

entities.name: Kaldar's Hall
entities.description: Home of the fire giant king.

entities.name: Vela Heights
entities.description: Peaks where frost giant wizards formed a community.

relations.quote: Surtland is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim .
